STA Main Chat

One company-wide assistant that knows how School Tech works.

What it will be

STA Main Chat is planned as the central, company-wide assistant - a single place any staff member can ask about how School Tech does things and get an answer grounded in our real workflows across every department.

What it depends on

The assistant is only as good as the workflow documentation behind it. Before it can launch, each department needs to share how its core processes actually work, so the assistant answers from real School Tech practice rather than guesswork.

Status: Waiting on department workflow documents. This launches once Tanya has collected the workflow documentation from each department. This page will be replaced with access steps and a getting-started brief at launch.

How you can help

  • When your department is asked for its workflows, write them down in plain steps.
  • Send them to Tanya so they can feed the assistant's knowledge base.
